story.title: Our story
story.body1: Born in 2005 in Riacho He Hé (Formosa), we built a warm, rigorous learning space for every age.
story.body2: We focus on dynamic, playful classes grounded in real-life situations so you use the language with confidence.

modalities.title: On-site & live online
modalities.intro: You can choose the format that fits your routine without giving up the same CEFR-based path, the Ministry of Education of Formosa recognition (Res. 1297/05), and our UTN and Cambridge preparation routes.

remota.b2: Reduced groups, guided conversation, and international-standard materials.
remota.b3: Ideal if you want to save travel time while keeping a rigorous rhythm.

origenes.title: Origins
origenes.body: Mozarthitos was born in 2022 alongside Ennio—son of founders and educators Felipe Andreani and Jane Guerra—professional musicians active in higher education, early-childhood music, and Chile’s performing scene.

llegada.title: Arrival in Chile
llegada.body: Seeking the best system to give babies musical education as a mother tongue from day one, they earned Spain’s Mago Diapasón diploma—becoming the first certified teachers in Chile and South America for this pioneering method.

felipe.p1: As a violist and faculty member at Universidad de Chile’s School of Arts—with additional training in Spain—his career spans national and international stages.
felipe.p2: He has performed in leading halls across Italy, France, Belgium, the UK, and Germany alongside artists such as Plácido Domingo and Cristina Gallardo-Domâs.
felipe.p3: As principal violist of the Orchestra of the Americas he toured Brazil under Kent Nagano.
felipe.p4: In the United States he joined the Solistas YOA ensemble as its sole violist at the Castleton Festival.
felipe.p5: Collaborations include Luis Miguel, Andrea Bocelli, Laura Pausini, Peter Gabriel, Raphael, Ennio Morricone, Marco Antonio Solís, Il Divo, Sarah Brightman, and more.
felipe.p6: After specialized infant music training in Spain, he founded Mozarthitos—the first center of its kind in Latin America.

jane.p1: Violinist and composer; graduated with honours from Universidad de Chile and studied at the University of Toronto’s summer academy.
jane.p2: She has performed chamber recitals at the CBC’s Glenn Gould Studio and refined her technique with Gerard Claret in Barcelona.
jane.p3: Credits span Inti Illimani, Jessy & Joy, Sarah Brightman, Ennio Morricone, recordings for Natalino and others, and productions such as HBO’s Prófugos.

cursos.subtitle: The Mago Diapasón method
cursos.bodyP1: Created by Paqui Castro, it teaches music to babies and toddlers through play, singing, and percussion—guided by the Mago Diapasón character and the story “Traveling to the land of music.”
cursos.bodyP2: 30-minute sessions start early; from age three children begin reading scores and building focus. The approach nurtures memory, creativity, attention, and social skills.

hero.kicker: Mi Mundo Early Childhood Center, Resistencia, Chaco
hero.title: Welcome to a place where imagination becomes reality..
hero.subtitle: Mi Mundo grows from a formative and educational approach where the early years of life are of paramount importance. We support growth from 45 days of age until 5 years old.

institucional.title: Mi Mundo — a community where children grow
institucional.bodyP1: We are an early childhood center in Resistencia, Chaco, supporting families through the first years of life — from 45 days to 5 years old — with a thoughtful, high-quality educational approach.
institucional.bodyP2: Our interdisciplinary team works with care, listening, and pedagogical rigor. We believe childhood is the protagonist, relationships matter, and beautiful spaces invite children to explore, play, and learn every day.
institucional.highlight2: Green courtyard, garden, and living nature

colonia.title: A summer to play, explore, and rest
colonia.bodyP1: During school holidays we run our summer camp: days filled with free play, art, music, movement, and outdoor experiences in our courtyards and nature corners.
colonia.bodyP2: For children aged 3 to 12 (places vary by age). Full or half-day options and healthy snacks. A safe, joyful space while families plan their summer.
colonia.bullet1: Outdoor time, creative workshops, and group play
colonia.bullet2: Seasonal enrollment — dates and fees published each year
colonia.note: Enrollment opens each season. Contact us or reserve a spot to receive dates, fees, and updates.

propuesta.title: Learning with the whole body, with all the senses
propuesta.bodyP1: At Mi Mundo we believe that childhood deserves beautiful spaces, real materials, and attentive adults. Our pedagogical approach is inspired by Reggio Emilia and the Pikler philosophy: we respect individual timelines, propose prepared environments, and support free play as the engine of learning.
propuesta.bodyP2: We have specialized teachers, bright spaces, and a green courtyard where nature enters the nursery every day.

bebes.descripcion: A warm, safe haven for first discoveries. We nurture the awakening of their senses with love, respectful care, and gentle stimulation that embraces their first steps in the world.

sala1.descripcion: Where curiosity becomes adventure. We foster autonomy and symbolic play in an environment designed for each child to explore, create, and build their own experiences with joy.

sala2.descripcion: A lively space for learning and imagination. Here, play is the engine that strengthens critical thinking and the ability to live together, co-creating projects that make sense of the world around them.

sala3.descripcion: The stage where autonomy flourishes and thinking expands. Through symbolic play and inquiry projects, we support children in discovering their talents, strengthening emotional security and their ability to build meaningful bonds in an environment designed to awaken their wonder.

sala4.descripcion: A space for intellectual adventure and creative expression. We integrate knowledge through active methodologies and experience labs, where each child, as the protagonist of their learning, develops critical, collaborative, and artistic tools that prepare them with confidence and curiosity for new challenges.

sala5.descripcion: The transition year. We prepare each child for primary school with confidence, curiosity, and joy.

sala6.descripcion: A space for expressive freedom and sensory experimentation. In our Atelier, children become the 'hundred languages' (Reggio Emilia), exploring open-ended, provocative materials to co-create meaning and make their thinking visible through many forms of art.

sala7.descripcion: The rhythmic pulse of our community. Through movement, song, and exploring instruments, we foster attentive listening, collaboration, and emotional expression, cultivating a shared aesthetic sensitivity across all ages.

sala8.descripcion: Our window to a global community. We integrate English playfully and naturally into daily routines, using pedagogical narratives, music, and role play, preparing children with confidence to communicate and live together in a multicultural world.

nagoProtocol.title: Admission and operating protocol
nagoProtocol.acceptLabel: I have read and understood the Capoeira Nagô Admission and Operating Protocol and I accept its rules and conditions.

inscription.title: 1. Enrollment and acceptance of the protocol
inscription.body: Every new student must complete the enrollment and registration form. Enrollment means the student — or, for minors, their guardian — knows and accepts this protocol. Information must be true and kept up to date. Any relevant change must be reported to the School. The School may update this protocol and will inform students and guardians in due time.

tuition.title: 2. Monthly fee and payment
tuition.body: The monthly fee is due within the first 5 calendar days of each month. Timely payment keeps the place in class and supports planning. Repeated late payment may lead to temporary suspension from class or loss of the assigned slot. The fee is the right to attend that month's classes, not a count of classes actually attended.

attendance.title: 3. Attendance and make-up classes
attendance.body: A student may make up a class only with at least 24 hours' notice and if another slot is available. Without 24 hours' notice the class counts as taken and is not make-up eligible. If the teacher cancels a class, the School will offer an alternative (another class, a special workshop, or another agreed format). If a direct make-up is not possible, the School will assess a suitable solution.

freeze.title: 4. Freezing continuity — temporary pause
freeze.body: A student may temporarily freeze continuity for holidays, illness, or force majeure. Notice must be given before the pause starts. Freezes are not retroactive. The monthly fee is not frozen automatically without prior notice. A freeze keeps the place so the student can return without a new enrollment, subject to the School's conditions.

events.title: 5. Events, rodas and special activities
events.body: The School will organize activities during the year that may include rodas, workshops, championships, meetings with other groups, cultural activities and special events. Participation is strongly encouraged: these activities are part of learning and development in capoeira. Some events may have extra costs, announced in advance.

conduct.title: 6. Conduct and coexistence
conduct.body: Students are expected to respect teachers, classmates, guardians and the space; be on time; use appropriate language; take part in good faith; and care for materials and facilities. Serious disrespect, aggression outside the practice, harassment, intimidation, discrimination or behavior that harms the group will not be tolerated.

health.title: 7. Health and responsibility
health.body: The student or guardian must report any health information relevant to practicing capoeira, including injuries, allergies, physical restrictions or conditions that may need special attention. Students must follow the teacher's safety instructions. The School is not responsible for consequences of withheld relevant information or deliberate disregard of safety instructions.

communication.title: 8. Official communication
communication.body: All relevant communication about payments, absences, freezes, activities, events or questions must go through the School's official channels. Contact details must be kept up to date. Clear, timely communication is a shared responsibility of the School, the student and the guardian.

termination.title: 9. Suspension or end of the relationship
termination.body: The School may suspend or end a student's continuity for repeated protocol breaches, serious coexistence violations, conduct that puts others at risk, or repeated failure to meet obligations to the School. The student or guardian may leave the School with reasonable notice.

attire.title: 10. Clothing and personal items
attire.body: Official class wear is a Capoeira Nagô T-shirt and white Capoeira Nagô trousers. Until a new student has the official uniform, comfortable sportswear that allows safe movement is fine. Clothing or accessories that restrict movement or cause accidents are not allowed. Each student must bring a personal water bottle and towel. The School is not required to provide these.

hygiene.title: 11. Hygiene and care of the space
hygiene.body: Students are expected to keep good personal hygiene, wear clean clothes to each class, keep the practice space tidy, and care for equipment. Repeated failure may be addressed with the student or, for minors, with their guardian.

declaration.title: Declaration and acceptance
declaration.body: I declare that the information on this Enrollment and Registration Form is true and correct. If I represent a minor, I authorize their enrollment and participation in regular Capoeira Nagô Chile classes and I commit to report any relevant change, especially those related to health and safety.

privacy.metaDescription: How the institute looks after family data when you reserve a place or book a trial class.
privacy.title: Privacy and terms
privacy.lead: At {{brand}} we look after your family's data. We do not sell it, publish it, or use it for anything other than running the class.

promise.title: Our promise
promise.body: The details you give us at pre-enrollment stay at the institute. Only authorized staff — administration, teachers, and people who coordinate schedules — can see them. We do not build lists for third parties or publish student documents or photos unless you ask us to.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: {{brand}} is responsible for this data. To see, correct, or ask us to delete it, use the institute contacts below.

what.title: What we ask for
what.body: For the student: name, ID document, and date of birth. If they are a minor, we also ask for the parent or guardian's name, ID, email, and phone. You choose a schedule or a trial class. We only ask for what we need to hold the place and reach you.

why.title: Why we use it
why.body: To reserve the place or book the trial class, build the student record, and write to you by email or WhatsApp. We do not use this data for other companies' advertising.

who.title: Who can see it
who.body: Only institute staff who need it to teach the class or coordinate with the family. The student's record — including a minor's ID document and date of birth — stays in our system. We do not send that file to outside companies.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body: The site uses an encrypted connection (HTTPS). Access is limited by account and role: a teacher does not see the same things as administration. We do not expose documents on public pages.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: If enrollment is not confirmed, we may archive or delete the request when we no longer need to reach you. If they join the institute, we keep the record for as long as that relationship lasts and as long as the law requires (for example, receipts).

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can ask to see, correct, or delete your family's data using the responsible party's email or phone above. If the student is a minor, the parent or guardian makes the request.

terms.title: Pre-enrollment conditions
terms.body: The details must be true. Sending the form does not guarantee a place until the institute confirms it. If the student is a minor, the parent or guardian is the one submitting. If the institute has its own protocol, that text is accepted separately when it applies.

adminContents.lead: Browse reusable global items in the repository, or open Learning Routes to order repository content toward pedagogical goals.
adminContents.contentsTablistAria: Switch between content repository and learning routes
adminContents.sectionModeLead: Create global routes and order repository content as route steps.
adminContents.learningRoutesLead: Create ordered global routes from repository content. Sections choose one later, or stay in free-flow mode.
adminContents.coursesLead: Package repository items into modules and lessons. Publish a price to list the course in the shop.
adminContents.courseCreateFailed: We could not create this course.
adminContents.courseNeedItem: Add a repository item before you create a course.
adminContents.courseAssignFailed: We could not assign this course.
adminContents.courseGrantFailed: We could not assign this course to that student.
adminContents.globalRouteLead: Design the reusable route once; assign it later from a section’s Learning route tab.
adminContents.newLearningRouteLead: Create a reusable global sequence from repository content.
adminContents.emptyLearningRoutes: No learning routes yet. Create the first global route to make it available from section details.
adminContents.deleteLearningRouteDescription: This cannot be undone. The route, its ordered steps, and any section assignments that point to it will be removed.
adminContents.deleteLearningRouteError: We could not delete this learning route. Refresh and try again.
adminContents.globalCreateLead: Create content once and reuse it later in section plans.
adminContents.globalFullPageLead: Compose text, embedded YouTube videos, inline images, tables, and audiovisual materials in a full-page editor.
adminContents.globalViewLead: Review the content exactly as a reusable learning resource before deciding to edit it.
adminContents.mediaViewerLead: Open uploaded images, videos, audio, music, and PDFs in the order defined by the content.
adminContents.audioPlaylistLead: Listen to class sounds, songs, and recordings as an ordered playlist.
adminContents.globalSaveError: We could not save this content. Check the fields and try again.
adminContents.repositoryStudioLead: Edit, move to archive, delete, and review reusable content without leaving the studio.
adminContents.repositoryActionFailed: We could not complete the action. The content may be linked to another record or the session may need refreshing.
adminContents.materialsSelectHint: Select or create global content before adding materials.
adminContents.draftMaterialsLead: Add uploads or embeds now, reorder them, and remove anything before saving.
adminContents.builderFileHint: Select one or more files; they upload in order and stay in the draft until you save. PDF, Office files, images, audio, and video are supported.
adminContents.editorPlaceholder: Write the lesson body. You can mix text, videos, images, tables, and links.
adminContents.editorBoldTooltip: Apply bold to the selected text.
adminContents.editorItalicTooltip: Apply italic to the selected text.
adminContents.editorHighlightTooltip: Toggle highlight background on the selected text.
adminContents.editorHeadingTooltip: Turn the current block into a level-2 heading.
adminContents.editorParagraphTooltip: Turn the current block into a normal paragraph.
adminContents.editorAlignLeftTooltip: Align the current paragraph or heading to the left.
adminContents.editorAlignCenterTooltip: Center-align the current paragraph or heading.
adminContents.editorBulletListTooltip: Start or toggle a bullet list for the current block.
adminContents.editorOrderedListTooltip: Start or toggle a numbered list for the current block.
adminContents.editorQuoteTooltip: Turn the current block into a quotation.
adminContents.editorLinkTooltip: Add or edit a hyperlink on the selection. A dialog asks for the URL—leave it empty to remove an existing link.
adminContents.editorYoutubeTooltip: Insert an embedded YouTube player (not a text link). Use this button or paste a watch/share URL in the body—watch URLs are not auto-linked so they can become a player. A dialog also accepts the URL.
adminContents.editorImageTooltip: Insert an image at the cursor from a PNG, JPEG, or WebP file. After it loads, click the image and drag a corner handle to resize (aspect ratio is kept).
adminContents.editorTableTooltip: Insert a 3×3 table with a header row. You can edit cells and add rows or columns after insertion.
adminContents.editorUndoTooltip: Undo the last change in the editor.
adminContents.editorRedoTooltip: Redo a change you previously undid.
adminContents.noMaterialsDraft: No materials in this draft yet.
adminContents.archiveConfirm: Move this global content to the archive? It will disappear from the active repository.
adminContents.deleteConfirm: Delete this global content permanently? Its draft blocks, reusable materials, and route steps that use it will be removed.
adminContents.deleteConfirmNoRouteSteps: This permanently removes the content, its draft blocks, and reusable materials. No learning route steps currently use it.
adminContents.deleteConfirmWithRouteSteps: This content is used by {count} learning route steps. Deleting it will also remove those route steps.
adminContents.globalFileError: The file is too large or not supported.

adminContents.noSection: Create or select a route scope before planning contents.
adminContents.routeWizardStepDetailsDescription: Name the route and define the pedagogical intention.
adminContents.routeWizardStepGraphDescription: Drag repository content, connect steps, and define checkpoints.
adminContents.routeWizardDetailsLead: Complete the route data first. When you continue, we will save it and open the visual graph builder automatically.
adminContents.routeWizardSaveErrorInvalidInput: We could not create the route because one field is invalid. Check the name and text lengths.
adminContents.routeWizardSaveErrorDuplicateTitle: A learning route with this name already exists. Use a different name.
adminContents.routeWizardSaveErrorSchemaNotReady: The learning routes database schema is not ready. Run the latest Supabase migrations and try again.
adminContents.routeWizardSaveErrorForbidden: Your session does not have admin permissions to create learning routes.
adminContents.routeWizardSaveErrorPersistFailed: We could not save the route in the database. Check the server logs for the [ge:server] saveLearningRouteAction:persist entry.
adminContents.generalScope: What this route will work on
adminContents.saveRouteBeforeEditingSteps: Save the route first; then the graph editor will be enabled.
adminContents.routeGraphRepositoryLead: Search reusable content, then drag it into the route canvas.
adminContents.routeGraphSelectEdge: Select a connector between two steps to configure an optional evaluation.
adminContents.routeGraphSaveError: We could not save the route graph. Review the nodes and assessments.

portalCalendar.title: My schedule
portalCalendar.adminLead: School-wide section times (America/Argentina/Cordoba). Use filters to narrow the view and subscription.

holiday.legend: Official institute closure. No regular classes; attendance alerts do not apply.

institutional_exam.legend: High-priority institute exam. Follow exam and grading workflows.

parent_meeting.legend: Meeting for parents or guardians. May include a video link when virtual.

trimester_admin.legend: Administrative milestone such as grade submission deadlines.

sync.title: Sync to your calendar
sync.lead: Creates a persistent subscription link you can add to Google Calendar or Outlook.
sync.google: On your computer, open Google Calendar. On the left, next to “Other calendars”, click “+” then “From URL”. Paste the link generated here.
sync.outlook: Go to “Add calendar” → “Subscribe from web”, paste the link, and assign a name (for example, your institute name).
sync.errorSave: Could not create the link. Try again.
sync.rotateHint: Use if the link may have been shared by mistake. The previous URL stops updating.
sync.rotateConfirm: Regenerate the calendar link? Subscriptions using the old URL will no longer receive updates.

specialAdmin.title: Special calendar events
specialAdmin.lead: Typed institute events (holidays, exams, parents' meetings, etc.) with a fixed color code. Scope controls who sees each row; subscription feeds use the same rules as the portal.

adminCommandPalette.title: Search students
adminCommandPalette.hint: Press Esc to close. Pick a student from the list to open their profile.
adminCommandPalette.placeholder: Type to filter or pick from the list…
adminCommandPalette.studentSearchTooltip: Prefix search on first name, last name, or ID document; an empty field loads a short alphabetical list.
adminCommandPalette.searchMin: Only shown when this field still needs more typed characters.

adminHelpLauncher.panelDesc: Explain this screen or choose a guided tutorial. There is no chat message box.

meta.title: Admin home
meta.description: Overview of the sidebar, top bar, and hub cards on your main dashboard.

intro.title: 🏠 Your admin home
intro.description:
This is the main admin dashboard: a snapshot of institute activity and shortcuts into the areas you use most.

This walkthrough is the only one that also explains the left menu and the top bar. On other screens, “Explain this screen” focuses on the page content only.

sidebar.title: 📂 Left menu
sidebar.description:
Use the sidebar to reach every admin area: cohorts & sections, users, registrations, payments, messages, public site, settings, and more.

Groups keep related tools together. Badges on some links (for example new registrations) highlight work that needs attention.

chromeHeader.title: ⬆️ Top bar
chromeHeader.description: The sticky header stays visible while you scroll. On the left: brand and a shortcut back to admin home. On the right: the actions we will walk through next.

chromeBackToSite.title: 🌐 View website
chromeBackToSite.description:
Opens the public site (landing and marketing pages) in this same browser tab.

Use it to check what families see without signing out of the admin tools.

chromeTeacherPortal.title: 🎓 Teacher dashboard
chromeTeacherPortal.description:
If your account also has teaching access, this shortcut opens the teacher workspace (sections, attendance, class tools).

If you do not see it, your admin profile is not linked to teaching access — that is normal for many staff accounts.

chromeSignOut.title: 🚪 Sign out
chromeSignOut.description:
Ends your session securely and returns you to the public site.

Always sign out on shared computers.

chromeLocale.title: 🗣️ Language
chromeLocale.description:
Switches the admin interface language (Spanish, English, or Portuguese) while keeping you on the same page.

It changes labels and help text — not your institute’s public content language settings.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Hub title
titleBlock.description: The page title and lead introduce this home view. Everything below is a live summary — not a separate settings page.

studentsWithoutSection.title: ⚠️ Students without a section
studentsWithoutSection.description:
When students are enrolled in the institute but not yet assigned to a class section, this banner appears with a count and a link to Users so you can fix it.

If you do not see it, every student currently has a section — that is normal.

birthdays.title: 🎂 Upcoming birthdays
birthdays.description: A friendly list of student birthdays coming up. Useful for classroom culture; it does not replace academic or billing workflows.

traffic.title: 📈 Site traffic
traffic.description:
Hits over the last 30 days, split between signed-in users and guests, plus a week-over-week trend.

Open the card to go to Analytics for deeper breakdowns.

users.title: 👥 Users
users.description: Total profiles in the institute and a quick split by role. Open the card to manage students, parents, teachers, and staff.

payments.title: 💳 Payments
payments.description:
Shows how many payments are waiting for review. When the count is zero, you are caught up.

Open the card to review receipts and pending items.

registrations.title: 📝 Registrations
registrations.description:
New public registration requests waiting for staff review, plus the overall total.

Open the card to process the queue.

messages.title: 💬 Messages
messages.description: Recent inbound messages and a short preview of the latest one. Open the card to read and reply in the messaging inbox.

closing.title: ✅ You are ready
closing.description:
That is the admin home. Use the left menu for day-to-day work, and open this help button anytime.

On other admin screens you can ask to explain that section’s content, or start a how-to tutorial such as creating a cohort.

chromeBell.title: 🔔 Alerts
chromeBell.description: The bell lists recent messages and new web registrations. No badge means nothing is waiting.

navInstitute.title: 🏛️ Institute
navInstitute.description: Calendar, events, site, analytics and the rest of setup live here. They are not on the daily list.

hubBoost.title: 🚀 Grow your institute
hubBoost.description: Shortcuts to create an event, a promotion, or publish to the blog. Not morning work.

sidebarProfile.title: 👤 Your account
sidebarProfile.description: At the bottom of the rail: your name, profile, language, and sign out.

meta.title: Users
meta.description: Directory of portal accounts: search, filter by role, and manage people.

intro.title: 👥 Users directory
intro.description:
This screen lists every portal profile in your institute (students, parents, teachers, staff).

Use it to find people, open a profile, or jump to create/import flows from the section tabs.

subnav.title: 📑 Section tabs
subnav.description: Switch between the user list, add-user form, and CSV import without leaving Users.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Page purpose
titleBlock.description: The title and lead remind you this is the live account directory for your project — not a separate CRM.

toolbar.title: 🔎 Search & role filters
toolbar.description: Search by email, name, phone, or ID. Role chips show counts and narrow the table so you can focus on one persona type.

table.title: 📄 Results table
table.description: Each row is a profile you can open or act on. Sort and pagination keep large directories manageable — totals come from the server, not just the current page.

closing.title: ✅ Next steps
closing.description: Open a row for detail, or use Add user / Import when you need to create accounts. Help stays available on other admin screens.

meta.title: Add user
meta.description: Create a single portal account with role, identity fields, and optional guardian link.

intro.title: ➕ Add user form
intro.description:
This page creates one profile at a time — student, parent, teacher, or staff.

Use it when you need careful data entry or guardian linking; bulk loads belong on Import.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Page purpose
titleBlock.description: The heading and lead explain that you are registering a new portal identity, not editing an existing row from the directory.

form.title: 📝 Account form
form.description: All required fields live in this panel. The form validates locally first, then the server enforces institute rules (roles, minors, duplicates).

role.title: 🎭 Role selector
role.description: Pick who this person is in the product. Role drives which extra blocks appear (birth date for students, email rules, guardian panel for minors).

credentials.title: 🔐 Login credentials
credentials.description: Set the password the person will use on first sign-in. For students who are minors, email may be synthetic until a guardian is linked.

guardian.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Guardian link (minors)
guardian.description: When the birth date marks a minor student, link an existing parent or capture a new guardian here before saving.

submit.title: ✅ Create account
submit.description: Submit only after reviewing role and identity. Success returns you to the user directory or detail — this tour never saves for you.

closing.title: ✅ Next steps
closing.description: Need many rows? Switch to Import users. To adjust someone later, open their profile from the Users list.

meta.title: Import users
meta.description: Upload a spreadsheet to preview new and duplicate rows before applying.

intro.title: 📤 Bulk import
intro.description:
Import users loads many accounts from Excel or CSV.

You always get a dry-run preview before anything is written — duplicates can be skipped or updated explicitly.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Page purpose
titleBlock.description: The title and lead describe the expected file shape and that import runs as a guided preview → confirm flow.

chooseFile.title: 📁 Choose spreadsheet
chooseFile.description: Pick your .xlsx or .csv file here. The app parses it server-side and shows counts of new, duplicate, and invalid rows — no silent writes.

closing.title: ✅ Next steps
closing.description: After preview, confirm only when counts look right. For one-off accounts, use Add user instead.

meta.title: User profile
meta.description: View and edit identity, academic, family, payments, and security for one account.

intro.title: 👤 User dossier
intro.description:
This page is the staff view of one portal account.

Tabs group summary fields, academic placement, family links, billing shortcuts, and security tools.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Identity header
titleBlock.description: Name, role badge, and email confirm which person you are editing. Student avatars can be updated here when your role allows inline edit.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Profile tabs
tabsIntro.description:
The underline bar groups everything staff can change about one account.

Click a tab to load its panel below — badges flag pending payments or academic items that need attention.

tabSummary.title: 👤 Summary tab
tabSummary.description:
Core identity fields: name, contact data, role, and inline profile edits allowed for your permissions.

Start here to confirm you opened the right person before changing academic or security settings.

tabAcademic.title: 🎓 Academic tab
tabAcademic.description:
Cohort placement, section enrollments, and academic shortcuts for students (and related tools for other roles).

Use it when moving someone between classes or reviewing which sections they belong to.

tabPayments.title: 💳 Payments tab
tabPayments.description:
Student-only shortcut to billing context: pending charges and a link to the full Student billing page.

Hidden for non-students. A badge shows open payment work.

tabFamily.title: 👨‍👩‍👧 Family tab
tabFamily.description:
Guardian ↔ student links for students, or linked wards for parent accounts.

Add or review tutors/guardians here instead of creating duplicate user records.

tabSecurity.title: 🔒 Security tab
tabSecurity.description:
Password resets, login email changes, and other sensitive account controls.

Changes may require step-up verification and notify the account holder — treat edits as high impact.

closing.title: ✅ Edit with care
closing.description: Security and billing changes affect live login and charges. Prefer the dedicated billing page for scholarships and payment history depth.

meta.title: Student billing
meta.description: Payment history, scholarships, and enrollment fee tools for one student.

intro.title: 💳 Billing workspace
intro.description:
This page concentrates tuition operations for a single student.

Pick a section benefit, review the month grid, then use tabs for history, scholarships, and enrollment fees.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Billing context
titleBlock.description: The title and student name line confirm whose ledger you are viewing — distinct from the lighter Payments tab on the profile.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Billing tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Three tabs sit under the monthly matrix for the selected section benefit.

Switch tabs to read history, manage scholarships, or review enrollment-fee status without leaving this student.

tabHistory.title: 📜 Payment history tab
tabHistory.description:
Read-only ledger of recorded payments for this student in the chosen section.

Use it to answer family questions or verify what was already marked paid — not to apply new scholarships.

tabScholarships.title: 🎓 Scholarships tab
tabScholarships.description:
Lists active percentage or fixed-amount scholarships and lets you remove ones that should end.

Apply new scholarships from the monthly matrix above; this tab focuses on reviewing and clearing existing benefits.

tabEnrollment.title: 📝 Enrollment fee tab
tabEnrollment.description:
Enrollment charge status, exemptions, and receipt context for the selected section.

Pair with the matrix when a family pays enrollment separately from monthly tuition.

closing.title: ✅ Keep ledgers accurate
closing.description: Record payments from the month grid above when families pay outside gateways. Use Scholarships for discounts before chasing overdue months.

meta.title: Registrations
meta.description: Public web registration requests waiting for staff review.

intro.title: 📝 Web registrations
intro.description: Families submit interest from the public site. This queue is where staff accept, edit, or decline those requests before they become portal users.

titleBlock.title: 📋 What this list is
titleBlock.description: The heading marks the registrations inbox — separate from the Users directory until someone is accepted.

toolbar.title: 🔎 Find a request
toolbar.description: Search and counters help you see how many requests match your filter versus the full queue.

table.title: 📄 Request rows
table.description: Each row is one registration with status and actions (accept, edit, delete). Process new items promptly so families are not left waiting.

closing.title: ✅ Keep the queue clear
closing.description: After accept, the person usually appears under Users. Return here whenever the sidebar badge shows new items.

meta.title: Events
meta.description: Create and manage institute events, capacity, and attendees.

intro.title: 📅 Events list
intro.description: Events are public or internal activities with dates, capacity, and optional payments. This list is the starting point to create or manage them.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Events overview
titleBlock.description: The title introduces the events workspace for your institute.

kpis.title: 📊 Quick counts
kpis.description: Upcoming and waitlist counts give a snapshot before you open a specific event.

createCta.title: ➕ Create event
createCta.description: Starts the create flow for a new event. Fill schedule and capacity carefully — attendees depend on those settings.

table.title: 📄 Event rows
table.description: Open Manage on a row to edit details, attendees, and exports. Status and capacity columns help prioritize.

closing.title: ✅ Run an event well
closing.description: Create early, monitor capacity, and use attendee tools on the event detail page.

meta.title: Create event
meta.description: Define schedule, capacity, and pricing before publishing.

intro.title: ➕ New event form
intro.description:
This page creates a single event record.

Set date, location, and capacity here — attendee registration and payments are configured after you save.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Page purpose
titleBlock.description: The heading explains you are drafting a new event, not editing an existing row from the list.

form.title: 📝 Event details
form.description: Title and description appear on the public event page when published. Keep wording clear for families scanning the calendar.

schedule.title: 🗓 Schedule & location
schedule.description: Event date and venue drive reminders and capacity checks. Double-check timezone-sensitive fields before saving.

pricing.title: 💳 Pricing
pricing.description: Optional local and non-local prices plus currency. Gateway availability may depend on finance settings configured elsewhere.

submit.title: ✅ Save event
submit.description: Saving creates the draft and opens the detail workspace. This tour never submits for you.

closing.title: ✅ Next steps
closing.description: After save, use the event detail tabs to publish, manage attendees, and review payments.

meta.title: Event detail
meta.description: Publish, edit form fields, attendees, payments, and notifications for one event.

intro.title: 📅 Event workspace
intro.description:
This page is the control room for a single event.

Tabs separate summary edits, registration form, attendees, payments, waitlist, and notifications.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Event identity
titleBlock.description: The title shows which event you are managing, with status and view count for quick context.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Event tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Each tab owns one slice of event operations — publishing, form fields, people, money, waitlist, and emails.

Use the bar to jump tasks without losing event context.

tabSummary.title: 📋 Summary tab
tabSummary.description:
Draft/publish state, pricing, schedule, and localized title and description.

Publish only when public copy and dates are final; unpublish hides the event while keeping registrations.

tabForm.title: 📝 Registration form tab
tabForm.description:
Built-in and custom fields families fill on the public registration page.

Adjust required questions here before sharing the event link.

tabAttendees.title: 👥 Attendees tab
tabAttendees.description:
Registered participants and their enrollment status for this event.

Use it for headcount, check-in prep, and manual status fixes.

tabPayments.title: 💳 Payments tab
tabPayments.description:
Transfer receipts and payment statuses tied to registrations.

Approve or reject proofs before marking attendees as fully paid.

tabCodes.title: 🎟 Discount codes
tabCodes.description:
Load codes for this event one by one, from Excel, or with the generator.

Each code has a use limit and a percent. Registration reserves a use.

tabWaitlist.title: ⏳ Waitlist tab
tabWaitlist.description:
People waiting for a spot when capacity is full.

Promote manually when seats open — promotion usually sends the family back through payment if required.

tabNotifications.title: 🔔 Notifications tab
tabNotifications.description:
Reminder and payment-decision emails triggered from default templates.

Review what the system sends so families are not surprised by automated messages.

publish.title: 🚀 Publish controls
publish.description: On the Summary tab, publish makes the event visible publicly; unpublish hides it while keeping registrations intact.

closing.title: ✅ Operate confidently
closing.description: Publish only when details are final, then monitor attendees and payments from the dedicated tabs.

meta.title: Finance
meta.description: Collections, payment inbox, event payments, insights, and finance settings.

intro.title: 💳 Finance hub
intro.description:
Finance brings tuition collections, receipt review, event payments, and trends into one tabbed hub.

Pick a tab for the job you need — do not confuse the payment inbox with the collections matrix.

header.title: 📋 Hub header
header.description: Confirms you are in the institute finance workspace.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Finance tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Five hub tabs separate collections health, receipt review, event money, trends, and configuration.

Badges on inbox-related tabs highlight pending approvals.

tabCollections.title: 📊 Collections tab
tabCollections.description:
Section-by-section collection health for the selected cohort, with export and bulk reminder tools.

Open a section row to drill into its monthly matrix and billing settings.

tabInbox.title: 📥 Payment inbox tab
tabInbox.description:
Approve or reject payment receipts uploaded by families — monthly tuition, enrollment fees, and invoice receipts in one queue.

This is not the collections matrix; it is proof review before invoices flip to paid.

tabEvents.title: 🎟 Events tab
tabEvents.description:
Review event payment statuses and pending event transfer receipts.

Use when workshops or camps collect money outside regular section billing.

tabInsights.title: 📈 Insights tab
tabInsights.description:
Collection trends, receipt processing metrics, year-end projections, and section health alerts.

Good for leadership reviews — not for day-to-day receipt clicks.

tabSettings.title: ⚙️ Settings tab
tabSettings.description:
Institute-wide finance preferences such as default currency and gateway-related options.

Changes here affect every section’s checkout experience.

cohortYear.title: 📆 Cohort & year
cohortYear.description: Filters collections and related views to a school year / cohort. Always check this before acting on numbers.

closing.title: ✅ Money workflows
closing.description: Review inbox items, reconcile collections, then use Insights for trends. Settings hold currency and gateway options.

meta.title: Section collections
meta.description: Monthly payment matrix, billing settings, history, scholarships, and enrollment fees for one section.

intro.title: 💳 Section collections
intro.description:
This drill-down focuses on one section's tuition matrix and related billing tools.

Use it after picking a section from the Finance hub collections overview.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Section header
titleBlock.description: Confirms the section name, cohort, and year filter. Use the back link to return to the hub matrix.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Section billing tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Five tabs cover the monthly matrix plus configuration, history, scholarships, and enrollment charges for one section.

Confirm the section header and year filter before acting on money.

tabMatrix.title: 📊 Collections matrix tab
tabMatrix.description:
Students × months grid showing paid, open, and overdue tuition cells for this section.

Record manual payments, send reminders, and spot gaps before families escalate.

tabSettings.title: ⚙️ Configuration tab
tabSettings.description:
Section billing rules that affect checkout, receipts, and proration for mid-month enrollments.

Misconfigured settings here propagate to every family in the class.

tabHistory.title: 📜 Payment history tab
tabHistory.description:
Paginated list of payments recorded for this section across all students.

Open flow detail when you need gateway settlement data for support.

tabScholarships.title: 🎓 Scholarships tab
tabScholarships.description:
Bulk and per-student scholarship tools scoped to this section.

Apply discounts before marking months paid — removing scholarships also happens here or from student billing.

tabEnrollment.title: 📝 Enrollment fees tab
tabEnrollment.description:
Enrollment charge configuration and bulk operations for this section’s intake fees.

Pair with the matrix when families pay enrollment separately from monthly plans.

closing.title: ✅ Reconcile here
closing.description: Fix overdue cells in the matrix, then use History or Scholarships when families need adjustments.

meta.title: Receipt review
meta.description: Compare a uploaded transfer receipt against the invoice and approve or reject.

intro.title: 🧾 Receipt review
intro.description:
Staff verify bank-transfer proofs before marking an invoice paid.

Open this screen from Finance → Payment inbox when a receipt waits approval.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Review title
titleBlock.description: Confirms you are in the split review layout for one pending receipt.

preview.title: 🖼 Receipt preview
preview.description: Image or PDF from the family upload. Zoom mentally on amount, date, and beneficiary before approving.

actions.title: ✅ Approve or reject
actions.description: Compare expected vs paid amounts, then approve or reject with a reason families will see.

closing.title: ✅ Decide promptly
closing.description: Pending receipts block enrollment flows. Return to the inbox after you finish.

meta.title: Academics
meta.description: Annual cohorts and the sections inside them.

intro.title: 🏫 Cohorts & sections
intro.description: A cohort is the annual container for the school year. Sections (shifts, courses) live inside a cohort — create the year first, then add sections.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Cohorts & sections
titleBlock.description: This screen lists cohorts and lets you open the one you work on.

newCohort.title: ➕ New cohort
newCohort.description: Creates another annual cohort. Prefer one cohort per calendar year unless you intentionally need another.

boardTabs.title: 📑 Current / Active / Archived
boardTabs.description: Organize cohorts by status so the current year stays easy to find.

cohortList.title: 📚 Cohort rows
cohortList.description: Open a cohort to manage its sections. You can also mark which cohort is current for the institute.

closing.title: ✅ Build the year
closing.description: Need a guided create flow? Use the task tutorials for New cohort or New section from this help panel.

meta.title: Cohort detail
meta.description: Overview, sections, retention, and transfer inbox for one academic year.

intro.title: 🎓 Cohort workspace
intro.description:
Each cohort groups sections for one academic year.

Use tabs to review KPIs, manage classes, follow retention risks, and handle transfer requests.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Cohort name
titleBlock.description: The heading shows which year you opened. Badges mark current or archived cohorts.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Cohort tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Four tabs keep annual operations in one place: headline metrics, class list, retention risks, and transfer requests.

Switch tabs instead of leaving the cohort page.

tabOverview.title: 📊 Overview tab
tabOverview.description:
Archive, restore, or delete the cohort and review headline metrics such as active students and section count.

Use lifecycle actions here when a school year ends — not from individual sections.

tabSections.title: 📚 Sections tab
tabSections.description:
Cards for every class in this cohort — add sections, open section detail, and copy designs from prior years.

Shifts and timetables belong in sections, not in separate cohorts.

tabRetention.title: ⚠️ Retention tab
tabRetention.description:
Students across this cohort’s sections who need follow-up for absences or low averages.

Coordinate outreach before problems compound across multiple classes.

tabTransfers.title: 🔁 Transfers tab
tabTransfers.description:
Pending teacher requests to move students between sections (into or out of this cohort).

Approve here instead of deleting and re-enrolling manually — history stays auditable.

closing.title: ✅ Keep structure tidy
closing.description: Archive cohorts when a year ends. Use transfers instead of manual enrollments when students move sections.

meta.title: Section attendance
meta.description: Matrix view to record present, absent, or late for each class day.

intro.title: ✅ Attendance matrix
intro.description:
This page records attendance for one section across scheduled class days.

Cells update student records used in reports and parent portals.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Section context
titleBlock.description: The title confirms you are in the attendance tool; the subtitle names the section.

workspace.title: 📊 Attendance shell
workspace.description: When the section has eligible class days, the matrix loads here. Empty states explain missing schedules or dates outside the term.

matrix.title: 🗓 Grid & view tabs
matrix.description: Switch between month and list views, then tap cells to set status. Future dates may stay read-only until the class day.

closing.title: ✅ Record promptly
closing.description: Take attendance soon after class so families see accurate data. Use the section page link above to return to enrollments and settings.

meta.title: Section detail
meta.description: Section hub with health overview and work-area cards for configuration, staff, route, fees, attendance, and roster.

intro.title: 📚 Section workspace
intro.description:
Each section is one class inside an annual cohort — create the cohort year first, then add sections for shifts and courses.

This page is the daily control room: health, schedule, staff, learning path, assessments, fees, attendance, and enrollments.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Section header
titleBlock.description:
Shows section name, cohort, lead teacher summary, and archive badges.

Lifecycle actions on the right archive or remove the section when it should no longer accept students.

hubAreas.title: 🗂 Work area cards
hubAreas.description:
Start here — each card opens one job: configuration, teachers, fees, attendance, students, and optional learning route or assessments when enabled for the section.

Inside an area, use Back to return here or the switcher to jump to another area without scanning a long tab strip.

hubOverview.title: 📊 Section pulse
hubOverview.description:
Below the cards: a short KPI strip, alert chips when needed, and two charts — attendance mix and payment debt.

Use these signals to decide which work area to open next.

closing.title: ✅ Daily operations
closing.description:
Work from the hub: configure dates and teachers, enroll students, then attendance and fees.

Open Finance → Collections when you need the monthly payment matrix for this section.

meta.title: Calendar
meta.description: School-wide schedule of classes, exams, and special events.

intro.title: 🗓️ Master calendar
intro.description: Shows institute schedule items across teachers and rooms — not only your personal agenda.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Schedule title
titleBlock.description: Confirms you are on the admin master calendar view.

filters.title: 🎛️ Teacher & room filters
filters.description: Narrow the board when the full schedule is dense.

schedule.title: 📐 Week board
schedule.description: Classes, exams, special events, and birthdays appear here with a legend. Use special-events management for one-off items when available.

closing.title: ✅ Stay oriented
closing.description: Filter first, then scan the board. Detail edits usually live on academic or events screens.

meta.title: Academic contents
meta.description: Global content repository and learning routes.

intro.title: 📚 Contents hub
intro.description: Reusable learning materials and routes live here. Repository templates are shared; routes assemble a learning path.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Contents title
titleBlock.description: Marks the academic contents workspace.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Contents tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Two tabs split reusable items from ordered learning paths.

Build templates first, then assemble routes that sections can adopt later.

tabRepository.title: 📚 Content repository tab
tabRepository.description:
Browse and create global learning materials: text, media, assessments, and templates shared across sections.

Nothing here is tied to a live class until a section or route references it.

tabRoutes.title: 🛤 Learning routes tab
tabRoutes.description:
Cards for global routes — ordered sequences built from repository content.

Sections pick a route on their Learning route tab or stay in free-flow mode.

closing.title: ✅ Content vs sections
closing.description: Assigning materials to a live class section usually happens from the section tools after content exists here.

meta.title: Badges
meta.description: Achievement badges students can earn.

intro.title: 🏅 Badges catalog
intro.description: Define badge criteria (tasks, attendance, community, …) that motivate students.

header.title: 📋 Badges header
header.description: Page title and context for the badges list.

createCta.title: ➕ Create badge
createCta.description: Opens the form to add a new badge with image, code, and criteria.

categoryTabs.title: 📑 Categories
categoryTabs.description: Filter badges by category so large catalogs stay scannable.

table.title: 📄 Badge rows
table.description: Edit, reorder, or deactivate badges from the table actions.

closing.title: ✅ Award thoughtfully
closing.description: Clear criteria prevent confusion. Keep inactive badges archived rather than deleting history carelessly.

meta.title: Coupons
meta.description: Discount codes for registration or payments.

intro.title: 🎟️ Discount coupons
intro.description: Create codes with type, value, validity window, and max uses. Active toggles control whether families can redeem them.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Coupons page
titleBlock.description: Create form and list share this screen.

createForm.title: ✍️ New coupon form
createForm.description: Fill code, discount type/value, and dates before submitting. Avoid overlapping ambiguous codes.

table.title: 📄 Existing coupons
table.description: Review uses and toggle active state. Deactivate instead of deleting when you need an audit trail.

closing.title: ✅ Share carefully
closing.description: Only publish codes when the campaign is ready — active coupons can be redeemed immediately.

meta.title: Promotions
meta.description: Named promotions with discount rules and applicability.

intro.title: 🎁 Promotions
intro.description: Promotions are structured offers (often broader than a single coupon code) with applicability rules.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Promotions page
titleBlock.description: Create and review promotions in one place.

createForm.title: ✍️ New promotion
createForm.description: Name, discount, and who it applies to. Double-check dates and limits before saving.

table.title: 📄 Promotion list
table.description: Track uses and status of each promotion from the table.

closing.title: ✅ Align with coupons
closing.description: Prefer one clear offer path for families so support is not confused between coupons and promotions.

meta.title: Messages
meta.description: Staff inbox for received and sent institute messages.

intro.title: 💬 Messaging
intro.description: Read inbound family/staff messages and review what you sent. Compose opens a separate write flow.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Messages title
titleBlock.description: You are in the admin messaging workspace.

composeCta.title: ✍️ Write message
composeCta.description: Starts a new outbound message to selected recipients.

tabsIntro.title: 📑 Mailbox tabs
tabsIntro.description:
Received and Sent split inbound threads from outbound mail you authored.

Filters above narrow by participant after you pick a direction.

tabInbox.title: 📥 Received tab
tabInbox.description:
Threads where teachers, staff, students, or the public contact form wrote to administration.

Clear this queue regularly — the sidebar badge tracks recent inbound volume.

tabSent.title: 📤 Sent tab
tabSent.description:
Everything this admin account sent from the portal compose flow.

Use it to confirm a message went out or to reopen a thread you started.

list.title: 📨 Thread list
list.description: Open a thread to read and reply. Unread or recent items usually sort near the top.

closing.title: ✅ Stay responsive
closing.description: Clear the inbound queue regularly — the sidebar badge tracks recent inbound volume.

meta.title: Compose message
meta.description: Write a new outbound message or reply to an inbound thread.

intro.title: ✍️ Compose flow
intro.description:
This page sends a single message to one recipient.

Use it for proactive outreach or replies opened from the inbox — not bulk campaigns.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Compose purpose
titleBlock.description: The heading confirms you are drafting a message, not browsing the mailbox list.

recipient.title: 👤 Recipient
recipient.description: Search and pick the profile who receives the message. Reply flows may pre-fill the sender from the thread you opened.

body.title: 📝 Message body
body.description: Rich text supports links and basic formatting. Keep tone clear — families read this in their portal inbox.

send.title: 📤 Send
send.description: Send delivers immediately to the recipient's inbox. This tour never submits for you.

closing.title: ✅ After sending
closing.description: Successful sends return to the list or show confirmation here. Follow up from Sent if you need the thread again.

meta.title: Message detail
meta.description: Read one thread, see participants, and reply or delete.

intro.title: 📨 Message thread
intro.description:
This page shows a single message with sender, recipient, body, and reply actions.

Use it to understand context before responding.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Detail heading
titleBlock.description: Confirms you are reading one message, not scanning the inbox list.

participants.title: 👥 From / To
participants.description: Shows who sent the message and who received it, with role badges for quick context.

body.title: 📄 Message content
body.description: Full HTML body as the recipient saw it. Empty bodies show a placeholder instead of a blank panel.

actions.title: ↩️ Reply & delete
actions.description: Reply opens compose with the sender pre-selected. Reply with default inserts your institute template. Delete removes the thread from your mailbox.

closing.title: ✅ Respond thoughtfully
closing.description: Prefer Reply with default for consistent tone on site-contact threads; use plain Reply when you need a custom answer.

meta.title: Email templates
meta.description: Edit transactional email subject and HTML for allowed staff.

intro.title: ✉️ Template editor
intro.description: Only platform mega-admins see this nav item. Changes affect emails the system sends — preview before saving.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Templates header
titleBlock.description: Context for the email template workspace.

select.title: 📑 Template & locale
select.description: Pick which template and language variant you are editing.

editor.title: 📝 Subject & body
editor.description: Edit subject and HTML carefully. Dangerous markup is sanitized on save.

preview.title: 👁️ Preview
preview.description: Check how the email will look before you commit changes.

closing.title: ✅ Save with intent
closing.description: Use Save when ready; Reset discards unsaved edits for the current selection.

meta.title: Blog
meta.description: Publish and manage public blog articles when blog is enabled.

intro.title: 📰 Blog articles
intro.description: Create drafts, submit for review, publish, pin, or archive articles that appear on the public site.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Blog list title
titleBlock.description: You are in the blog CMS list.

articleList.title: 🃏 Article cards
articleList.description: Status, views, and row actions (publish, pin, archive, delete, copy link) live on each card.

closing.title: ✅ Publish with care
closing.description: Preview public URLs after publish. Pin only cornerstone posts.

meta.title: New blog article
meta.description: Draft a multilingual article before review or publish.

intro.title: ✍️ New article editor
intro.description:
This page creates a blog draft.

Write title, body, and metadata per locale tab — nothing goes public until you publish from the list or after review.

editor.title: 📝 Editor workspace
editor.description: Locale tabs switch which translation you edit. The hint below the tabs confirms the active language.

titleField.title: 📌 Title
titleField.description: Headline shown on the public blog and in admin cards. Keep it specific — families scan titles first.

body.title: 📄 Body
body.description: Rich text, images, and embedded media for the article. Use materials below the editor when you need downloadable files.

meta.title: 🏷 Status & scheduling
meta.description: Status, tags, schedule date, and pin control publication behavior. Draft is safe while you iterate.

save.title: 💾 Save article
save.description: Persists the current locale and metadata. Saving does not publish — it keeps your draft on the server.

closing.title: ✅ Next steps
closing.description: After the first save, use the blog list to submit for review, publish, or share preview links.

meta.title: Edit blog article
meta.description: Update copy, materials, and publication settings for one article.

intro.title: ✍️ Article editor
intro.description:
You are editing an existing blog record.

Changes affect the public page once published — check locale tabs before saving.

editor.title: 📝 Editor workspace
editor.description: Same layout as new articles: locale tabs, fields, metadata, and save. Translate buttons appear when Google Translate is configured.

titleField.title: 📌 Title
titleField.description: Update the headline for the active locale. Slugs and share links may depend on saved titles.

body.title: 📄 Body
body.description: Revise rich content and attachments. Published edits are visible to visitors after save.

meta.title: 🏷 Status & scheduling
meta.description: Move between draft, pending review, scheduled, published, or archived. Pin only cornerstone posts.

save.title: 💾 Save article
save.description: Writes your edits for the active locale. This tour never saves for you.

closing.title: ✅ Publish with care
closing.description: Use share links to preview before promoting. Delete controls appear only for roles allowed to remove articles.

meta.title: Glossary
meta.description: Shared vocabulary for cohorts, sections, finance, and more.

intro.title: 📖 Terms glossary
intro.description: Use this reference when onboarding staff or clarifying product language. It does not change data — it teaches the model.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Glossary title
titleBlock.description: Marks the help glossary screen.

hierarchy.title: 🏗️ Entity hierarchy
hierarchy.description: Cohort → section → … explains how academic containers nest. Read this before creating structure.

groups.title: 📚 Term groups
groups.description: Expand Academic, Finance, and other groups for definitions and cross-links.

closing.title: ✅ Share the language
closing.description: Point teammates here when a term is ambiguous — better than reinventing names.

meta.title: Analytics
meta.description: Traffic, geography, and usage charts for the institute site.

intro.title: 📈 Analytics & usage
intro.description: Explore how guests and signed-in users move through the site. Charts are observational — they do not change configuration.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Analytics title
titleBlock.description: You are on the analytics dashboard.

traffic.title: 📊 Traffic summary
traffic.description: High-level hit counts and trends. Start here before drilling into geography.

charts.title: 🗺️ Maps & breakdowns
charts.description: Geo maps, path breakdowns, hourly activity, and funnels live in this region. Scroll to compare views.

closing.title: ✅ Interpret carefully
closing.description: Spikes can be bots or campaigns. Pair charts with operational context before changing marketing or capacity.

meta.title: Audit trail
meta.description: Searchable log of staff and system configuration actions.

intro.title: 📜 Audit trail
intro.description: When something changed — who, what domain, which resource. Essential for support and compliance.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Audit title
titleBlock.description: Marks the audit log screen.

toolbar.title: 🔎 Filters
toolbar.description: Narrow by domain, action, dates, actor, or free-text. Tight filters keep results useful.

table.title: 📄 Audit rows
table.description: Each row is an event. Open details when you need the payload context.

closing.title: ✅ Investigate calmly
closing.description: Combine actor + time range filters before assuming a bug. Export needs are usually handled outside this view.

meta.title: CMS

intro.title: 🎨 Site content hub
intro.description: Jumping-off point for theme/templates CMS and blog management — not the academic contents library.

titleBlock.title: 📋 CMS title
titleBlock.description: Confirms the site content management hub.

templatesCard.title: 🧩 Templates
templatesCard.description: Open site templates to edit branding surfaces and page templates.

blogCard.title: 📰 Blog card
blogCard.description: When blog is enabled for the tenant, this card links to the article list.

closing.title: ✅ Pick a destination
closing.description: Use Initial setup for wizard-style brand onboarding; use CMS templates for advanced edits.

intro.title: 🪄 Initial setup wizard
intro.description: Step-by-step branding and operational defaults. Complete steps in order; uploads show inline progress.

stepIndicator.title: 📍 Step progress
stepIndicator.description: Shows which wizard step you are on (e.g. 3 of 8).

panel.title: 📝 Step fields
panel.description: Fill the active step carefully — logos and colors feed the public brand layer.

nav.title: ⬅️➡️ Wizard navigation
nav.description: Back, Next, and Submit move through the wizard. Do not close mid-upload.

closing.title: ✅ Finish the wizard
closing.description: After submit, verify the public site reflects branding. Advanced tweaks may live under CMS.

titleBlock.title: 📋 Settings title
titleBlock.description: You are editing institute-scoped settings, not a single user profile.

inscriptions.title: 📝 Public registrations

classReminders.title: ⏰ Class reminders
classReminders.description: Configure automated reminders so students/families get timely class notices.

blogTranslate.title: 🌐 Translate helper

closing.title: ✅ Change deliberately
closing.description: Settings are institute-wide. Confirm with your team before disabling registrations mid-campaign.

emailSends.title: ✉️ Email sends

header.title: 📋 Profile header
header.description: Title and navigation back to where you came from.

avatar.title: 🖼️ Avatar

personalForm.title: ✍️ Personal fields
personalForm.description: Name, phone, document, and address fields used across the product.

password.title: 🔐 Password
